headline: Bluesky blocks links to leaked DHS employee data archive
summary: Bluesky blocked links to a leaked archive containing contact information for tens of thousands of ICE, CBP and other Department of Homeland Security employees, saying the data was shared without the workers' authorization. The move has drawn criticism, with the government seeking takedowns of the leaked material.
